description: This file contains integration tests for fixed-length loan products in the Fineract project, including creating, reading, updating loan products, and applying for loans with fixed-length settings.

classes.name: FixedLengthLoanProductIntegrationTest
classes.description: A class containing JUnit test cases for testing fixed-length loan products in Fineract.

methods.name: testCreateReadUpdateReadLoanProductWithFixedLength
methods.description: Tests creation, retrieval, updating, and nullification of the fixedLength property in loan products.

methods.name: testLoanApplicationWithFixedLengthInheritedFromLoanProduct
methods.description: Tests applying for a loan where the fixedLength is inherited from the loan product.

methods.name: testLoanApplicationWithFixedLengthOverriddenByLoanApplication
methods.description: Tests applying for a loan with a fixedLength value overridden in the loan application.

methods.name: fixedLengthLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product request with fixed length and other parameters.
